dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures in the mid-lateral field show a sharp gradient transition from a dark dorsal background to a high-contrast light-grey perimeter. The edges are non-uniform and crenulated, enclosing an interior region that is darker than the ring but lighter than the exterior coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-grey pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily distributed in the spaces between major annuli and along the upper-dorsal curvature.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent central annuli form an approximate obtuse triangle; several smaller high-intensity blobs form a secondary linear cluster extending towards the posterior-dorsal region.
